queries.text: Series title follows the glossary proposal "Man’s Suffering in Love" (O Sofrimento Amoroso do Homem), as in the other volumes.
Subtitle "As artimanhas e os truques ardilosos das mulheres no amor". "artimanhas" → "wiles" (glossary). Alternative: "Women’s Wiles and Cunning Tricks in Love".
The citation gives the English titles; the Portuguese originals are "O Sofrimento Amoroso do Homem" and "A Guerra da Paixão (As artimanhas e os truques ardilosos das mulheres no amor)".

The author’s notice forbids any alteration of the book’s "language or title". Translated faithfully; a human should confirm that this English edition is authorized before publication (as for the other volumes).
